newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Paint to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Paint to issue new shares.

text.p: Ailing Thai paint company BPT Industries Plc plans to issue 300 million new shares by private placement to fund diversification into the Thai property sector, the company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange on Monday.
The share issue is part of a financial rescue plan which will see BPT raise its registered capital from 180 million baht (US$7.0 million) to 3.18 billion baht, the company said.

The proceeds will help fund the firm's planned 2.375 billion baht acquisition of 20.9 million shares, or 100 percent, of developer Suvit and Seri Co Ltd, conditional on the latter securing unspecified land for development.

Bangkok Paint will spend a further 657 million baht, paid in installments over 18 months, to buy three property projects, Seri Bagna 1, Seri Place and Seri Villa currently owned by property company Suvit and Seri Ltd.
The plans are subject to shareholders' approval.
